Title: Ajay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ajay - 32 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Anjali - 29 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Sunita - 58 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Ajay stands on the training ground. Anjali and Sunita stand near him.]

Anjali: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ajay practises sword fighting.]

Ajay (excited): "Mother, listen!"

[Ajay draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Sunita: "That was fun!"

[Anjali rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Anjali (laughing): "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The bathroom - Day

[Ajay stands in the bathroom. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Let's begin."

[Ajay shaves in front of the mirror.]

Ajay: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Ajay stands in the living room. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Ajay, look over here."

[Ajay drinks a beer.]

Ajay: "I knew it!"

[Ajay staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Ajay: "That was such a fun day!"
